text: Hi, I'm Bill Carter. I want to know how much it costs to replace a whole bathroom's plumbing.
Our diagnostic visit is $89 to assess the job and give you an exact estimate. Would you like to schedule a visit for an technician to take a look?
Can't you just give me a ballpark number?
We require an on-site visit to provide accurate pricing for major projects like bathroom plumbing. Would you like me to check our available times for a diagnostic visit?
Come on, surely you've done enough of these to give me a rough idea. Even a wide range would help.
I can only quote our standard $89 diagnostic visit fee, as full bathroom replacements depend on the specific layout and scope. Would you like to schedule a visit, or speak with someone directly?
No thanks, I'm just shopping around. Bye.
Thanks for calling Lakeside Plumbing & Heating. Have a great weekend!
